+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+cat > schema.sql <<'EOF'
+CREATE TABLE customers (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE orders (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
+    total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);
+EOF
--- a/_gp_transform.py
+++ b/_gp_transform.py
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+"""Rewrite outputs after the original entry runs."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+TARGETS = ['schema.sql']
+
+
+def drop_last_line(text):
+    lines = text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
+    end = "\n" if text.endswith("\n") else ""
+    return "\n".join(lines[:-1]) + (end if len(lines) > 1 else "")
+
+
+def transform_file(text):
+    return drop_last_line(text)
+
+
+def transform_stdout(out):
+    return out
+
+
+def main():
+    captured = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+    out = captured.read_text() if captured.exists() else ""
+    for name in TARGETS:
+        path = pathlib.Path(name)
+        if path.is_file():
+            path.write_text(transform_file(path.read_text()))
+    sys.stdout.write(transform_stdout(out))
+
+
+main()
